name: AI for Teachers
description: Awarded for completing and passing the AI for Teachers track: AI fundamentals for educators, AI-resilient assessment design, planning and differentiation with AI, pupil data protection, and writing a school AI policy.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 8 lessons and their interactive labs — including a flagged-essay simulator and a written policy task assessed against a rubric — then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
